_geoverse_header.change_summary: Record committed owned-scope cleanup, red/green proofs, strict build, generated-source blockers and the unowned navigation-test failure.

head: 0bdbae3bc7c18a2d83d9e97db29d13ded56cdd23
head_scope: Tested implementation head before the report-only commit; this report does not claim an integrated release.
report_routing: Owner-supplied worktree path; all writes and commits stay in this lane. No external report or estate file was edited.

items.evidence: The deferred-integration page leaves nav and is excluded from the site. Architecture and upgrading omit its name; the removed-function reason and owned pinned tests move together. All 356 rendered articles contain zero mentions. The requested physical archive move is not performed because docs/unpublished is read-only; the source stays excluded in place.

All owned authored pages, percent-format example introductions and input_template module docstring state behavior without release narration. Historical roll/yaw release bounds are retained on upgrading. Remaining generated API, CLI and command-reference narration requires unowned source files listed here and in rendered_audit.

All owned authored pages and the geometry API docstrings omit dated editing narration; evidence timestamps and data examples remain. Generated API, FSI tutorial and command-reference narration outside the ownership grant remains, with rendered evidence and source homes listed.

Concepts has one generated architecture page. Contributing links to its architectural-decisions section by canonical URL, which passes ProperDocs strict mode. The SRS source is excluded as a duplicate site page and its owned nav pin is updated. The remaining unowned delivery test treats every section URL as a missing file.
items.required_integration_change: At test_every_documented_page_is_built_and_reachable, resolve same-site section URLs to their generated page and validate the fragment; do not accept arbitrary missing links. The current unresolved comprehension at lines 331-336 only accepts exact Markdown targets or strings ending in a slash.

validation.failure: test_goal033_delivery.py::test_every_documented_page_is_built_and_reachable: rejects the canonical architecture section URL as a missing menu page.
validation.touched_tests: All touched tests passed in the full lane suite. The failing file was read but not edited.
validation.ruff: ruff check and ruff format --check passed on all touched Python files; commit hooks passed.
validation.mypy: mypy --follow-imports=silent on each touched Python file passed under the repository configuration. Two annotation-unchecked notes in the existing reference test are not errors.
validation.initial_suite: 3 failed, 1046 passed, 2 skipped: fixed a legacy anchor, remaining short release labels and placement of temporary test fixtures. Later nav-relative-link failures were corrected to the canonical URL; the unowned URL pin remains.
validation.example_environment: An initial test_examples run had two subprocess import errors without PYTHONPATH; the final 38-file run supplied the lane source path and both passed.
validation.final_migration_guard_check: 10 passed in 1.63s; P0420 guard file and both affected far-field migration checks through memgate after the final migration paragraph.
